new_value: {"notes":"Closed as superseded/stale without code changes. Normative spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.4 requires the combined 24-bit counter to use ordinary unsigned ordering, explicitly not RFC 1982 serial/modulo arithmetic. Epoch 255 MUST NOT wrap to 0; same-epoch seqnum wrap is stale; (255,65535) is terminal and requires key rotation. Implementing requested half-range/wrap behavior would accept forbidden replay transitions. Existing Python/Rust implementations and canonical epoch_rollover.json + replay_window.json already enforce the spec. Verification green: Python focused replay logical/epoch/wrap tests 18 passed; Rust epoch_serial_vectors 1 passed, seqnum unit tests 6 passed, replay unit tests 9 passed; cargo check -p lichen-link --no-default-features passed."}
